+"""Customer Outcomes CLI subcommands.
+
+Customer Outcomes link customer value to business value. Every command works
+against whichever backend is selected (local SQLite by default, or a remote MCP
+server via ``--backend mcp``).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Any
+
+import typer
+
+from agentic_odi_cli.backend import run_tool
+from agentic_odi_cli.render import (
+    render_customer_outcome,
+    render_customer_outcome_list,
+    render_deleted,
+    render_saved,
+    render_score,
+)
+
+customer_outcomes_app = typer.Typer(help="Manage Customer Outcomes.")
+
+
+class DirectionOption(str, Enum):
+    MINIMIZE = "minimize"
+    MAXIMIZE = "maximize"
+
+
+class CategoryOption(str, Enum):
+    REVENUE_GROWTH = "revenue_growth"
+    COST_REDUCTION = "cost_reduction"
+    RETENTION = "retention"
+    RISK_MITIGATION = "risk_mitigation"
+    OPERATIONAL_EFFICIENCY = "operational_efficiency"
+    COMPLIANCE = "compliance"
+    BRAND_REPUTATION = "brand_reputation"
+    OTHER = "other"
+
+
+JSON_OPTION = typer.Option(False, "--json", help="Emit machine-readable JSON.")
+
+
+@customer_outcomes_app.command("add")
+def add(
+    job_id: str = typer.Option(..., help="Job ID the outcome belongs to"),
+    direction: DirectionOption = typer.Option(..., help="minimize | maximize"),  # noqa: B008
+    unit_of_measure: str = typer.Option(..., "--unit"),
+    object_of_control: str = typer.Option(..., "--object"),
+    statement: str = typer.Option(..., help="Full outcome statement"),
+    importance: float = typer.Option(..., min=1.0, max=10.0),
+    satisfaction: float = typer.Option(..., min=1.0, max=10.0),
+    category: CategoryOption = typer.Option(..., help="Business impact category"),  # noqa: B008
+    business_statement: str = typer.Option(..., help="Business value statement"),
+    contextual_clarifier: str | None = typer.Option(default=None),
+    step_id: str | None = typer.Option(default=None),
+    json_output: bool = JSON_OPTION,
+) -> None:
+    """Add a Customer Outcome with customer and business value."""
+    customer_value: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "direction": direction.value,
+        "unit_of_measure": unit_of_measure,
+        "object_of_control": object_of_control,
+        "statement": statement,
+        "importance": importance,
+        "satisfaction": satisfaction,
+    }
+    if contextual_clarifier:
+        customer_value["contextual_clarifier"] = contextual_clarifier
+    args: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "job_id": job_id,
+        "customer_value": customer_value,
+        "business_value": {"category": category.value, "statement": business_statement},
+    }
+    if step_id:
+        args["step_id"] = step_id
+    result = run_tool("add_customer_outcome", args)
+    typer.echo(render_saved("created", result, as_json=json_output))
+
+
+@customer_outcomes_app.command("get")
+def get(
+    outcome_id: str = typer.Argument(...),
+    json_output: bool = JSON_OPTION,
+) -> None:
+    """Get a Customer Outcome by ID."""
+    result = run_tool("get_customer_outcome", {"outcome_id": outcome_id})
+    typer.echo(render_customer_outcome(result, as_json=json_output))
+
+
+@customer_outcomes_app.command("list")
+def list_outcomes(
+    job_id: str | None = typer.Option(default=None, help="Filter by job ID"),
+    json_output: bool = JSON_OPTION,
+) -> None:
+    """List Customer Outcomes."""
+    args: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if job_id:
+        args["job_id"] = job_id
+    result = run_tool("list_customer_outcomes", args)
+    typer.echo(render_customer_outcome_list(result, as_json=json_output))
+
+
+@customer_outcomes_app.command("update")
+def update(
+    outcome_id: str = typer.Argument(...),
+    importance: float | None = typer.Option(default=None, min=1.0, max=10.0),
+    satisfaction: float | None = typer.Option(default=None, min=1.0, max=10.0),
+    direction: DirectionOption | None = typer.Option(default=None),  # noqa: B008
+    unit_of_measure: str | None = typer.Option(default=None, help="Unit of measure"),
+    object_of_control: str | None = typer.Option(default=None, help="Object of control"),
+    contextual_clarifier: str | None = typer.Option(default=None),
+    statement: str | None = typer.Option(default=None),
+    category: CategoryOption | None = typer.Option(default=None),  # noqa: B008
+    business_statement: str | None = typer.Option(default=None),
+    detail: str | None = typer.Option(default=None),
+    estimated_annual_value: float | None = typer.Option(default=None),
+    confidence: float | None = typer.Option(default=None),
+    step_id: str | None = typer.Option(default=None),
+    json_output: bool = JSON_OPTION,
+) -> None:
+    """Update a Customer Outcome."""
+    args: dict[str, Any] = {"outcome_id": outcome_id}
+    if step_id is not None:
+        args["step_id"] = step_id
+    if importance is not None:
+        args["importance"] = importance
+    if satisfaction is not None:
+        args["satisfaction"] = satisfaction
+    if direction is not None:
+        args["direction"] = direction.value
+    if unit_of_measure is not None:
+        args["unit_of_measure"] = unit_of_measure
+    if object_of_control is not None:
+        args["object_of_control"] = object_of_control
+    if contextual_clarifier is not None:
+        args["contextual_clarifier"] = contextual_clarifier
+    if statement is not None:
+        args["statement"] = statement
+    if category is not None:
+        args["category"] = category.value
+    if business_statement is not None:
+        args["business_statement"] = business_statement
+    if detail is not None:
+        args["detail"] = detail
+    if estimated_annual_value is not None:
+        args["estimated_annual_value"] = estimated_annual_value
+    if confidence is not None:
+        args["confidence"] = confidence
+    result = run_tool("update_customer_outcome", args)
+    typer.echo(render_saved("updated", result, as_json=json_output))
+
+
+@customer_outcomes_app.command("delete")
+def delete(
+    outcome_id: str = typer.Argument(...),
+    yes: bool = typer.Option(False, "--yes", "-y", help="Skip confirmation"),
+    json_output: bool = JSON_OPTION,

+    """Delete a Customer Outcome."""
+    if not yes:
+        confirm = typer.confirm(f"Delete customer outcome {outcome_id}?")
+        if not confirm:
+            raise typer.Exit()
+    result = run_tool("delete_customer_outcome", {"outcome_id": outcome_id})
+    typer.echo(render_deleted(result, as_json=json_output))
+
+
+def score(
+    importance: float = typer.Argument(..., min=1.0, max=10.0),
+    satisfaction: float = typer.Argument(..., min=1.0, max=10.0),
+    json_output: bool = JSON_OPTION,
+) -> None:
+    """Compute an ODI Opportunity Score."""
+    result = run_tool(
+        "compute_opportunity",
+        {"importance": importance, "satisfaction": satisfaction},
+    )
+    typer.echo(render_score(importance, satisfaction, result, as_json=json_output))
+
+
+customer_outcomes_app.command(name="score")(score)

+"""First-run onboarding: page fetch, HTML signal extraction, confirmation card, typed fallback."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+import sys
+
+import httpx
+import typer
+
+from agentic_odi_cli import profile
+
+# ── PageSignals ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+
+class PageSignals:
+    """Extracted signals from a fetched page."""
+
+    __slots__ = (
+        "title",
+        "meta_description",
+        "domain",
+        "primary_user",
+        "business_model",
+        "core_problem",
+        "current_focus",
+        "confidence",
+    )
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        title: str,
+        meta_description: str,
+        domain: str | None,
+        primary_user: str | None,
+        business_model: str | None,
+        core_problem: str | None,
+        current_focus: str | None,
+        confidence: str | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.title = title
+        self.meta_description = meta_description
+        self.domain = domain
+        self.primary_user = primary_user
+        self.business_model = business_model
+        self.core_problem = core_problem
+        self.current_focus = current_focus
+        self.confidence = confidence
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"PageSignals(title={self.title!r}, domain={self.domain!r}, confidence={self.confidence!r})"
+
+
+# ── Keyword-based inference ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+DOMAIN_KEYWORDS: dict[str, int] = {
+    "devtools": 3,
+    "error": 2,
+    "tracking": 1,
+    "monitoring": 1,
+    "sentry": 2,
+    "performance": 1,
+    "analytics": 1,
+    "optimization": 1,
+}
+
+CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 3
+
+
+def infer_baseline(signals: PageSignals) -> tuple[profile.Baseline, dict[str, int]]:
+    """Deterministic keyword-based inference from extracted page signals.
+
+    Returns a Baseline and a dict of per-domain keyword scores.
+    """
+    scores: dict[str, int] = {}
+    text = (signals.title or "") + " " + (signals.meta_description or "")
+    for keyword, weight in DOMAIN_KEYWORDS.items():
+        count = text.lower().count(keyword)
+        if count:
+            scores[keyword] = count * weight
+
+    top_keyword = max(scores, key=lambda keyword: scores[keyword], default=None)
+    confidence = "high" if top_keyword and scores[top_keyword] >= CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD else "low"
+
+    # Map domain from signals; fall back to empty string if none
+    domain = signals.domain or ""
+
+    return profile.Baseline(
+        schema_version=1,
+        source="url",
+        product_name=None,
+        product_url=None,
+        domain=domain,
+        primary_user=signals.primary_user,
+        business_model=signals.business_model,
+        core_problem=signals.core_problem,
+        current_focus=signals.current_focus,
+        confidence=confidence,
+    ), scores
+
+
+# ── URL signal fetching ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+UA = "agentic-odi/0.1.0"
+
+
+def fetch_signals(url: str, timeout: float = 8.0) -> tuple[profile.Baseline | PageSignals, bool]:
+    """Fetch *url* and extract PageSignals.
+
+    Returns (signals, low_confidence) where low_confidence=True means the
+    inference confidence was "low" (≤2 keyword matches) — the caller should
+    fall back to the typed path.
+    """
+    try:
+        response = httpx.get(url, timeout=timeout, headers={"User-Agent": UA})
+        response.raise_for_status()
+    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - any fetch failure falls back to the typed path
+        # Fetch failure → typed path
+        return _default_signals(low_confidence=True)
+
+    signals = _extract_signals(response.text, str(response.url))
+    baseline, scores = infer_baseline(signals)
+    low_confidence = baseline.confidence == "low"
+    return baseline, low_confidence
+
+
+def _default_signals(low_confidence: bool = False) -> tuple[PageSignals, bool]:
+    return PageSignals(
+        title="",
+        meta_description="",
+        domain=None,
+        primary_user=None,
+        business_model=None,
+        core_problem=None,
+        current_focus=None,
+        confidence="low" if low_confidence else "high",
+    ), low_confidence
+
+
+def _extract_signals(html: str, url: str) -> PageSignals:
+    """Extract signals from HTML using stdlib html.parser."""
+
+    title = ""
+    meta_description = ""
+
+    # Simple regex-based extraction (no external parser dependency)
+    t = re.search(r"<title>([^<]*)</title>", html, re.IGNORECASE)
+    if t:
+        title = t.group(1).strip()
+
+    m = re.search(
+        r'<meta\s+name=["\']description["\']\s+content=["\']([^>]*)["\']',
+        html,
+        re.IGNORECASE,
+    )
+    if m:
+        meta_description = m.group(1).strip()
+
+    # Very simple domain extraction from the URL
+    from urllib.parse import urlparse
+
+    parsed = urlparse(url)
+    domain = parsed.hostname or None
+
+    # Simple primary_user and business_model extraction from title/meta
+    # (placeholder: derive from title tokens)
+    primary_user = None
+    business_model = None
+    core_problem = None
+    current_focus = None
+
+    # Compute confidence based on keyword scores
+    scores = {}
+    text = (title or "") + " " + (meta_description or "")
+    for keyword, weight in DOMAIN_KEYWORDS.items():
+        count = text.lower().count(keyword)
+        if count:
+            scores[keyword] = count * weight
+
+    top_keyword = max(scores, key=lambda keyword: scores[keyword], default=None)
+    confidence = "high" if top_keyword and scores[top_keyword] >= CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD else "low"
+
+    return PageSignals(
+        title=title,
+        meta_description=meta_description,
+        domain=domain,
+        primary_user=primary_user,
+        business_model=business_model,
+        core_problem=core_problem,
+        current_focus=current_focus,
+        confidence=confidence,
+    )
+
+
+# ── Confirmation card ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+CARD_LINES: tuple[str, ...] = (
+    "Based on the page you're visiting, we've detected the following:",
+    "",
+    "Product: <product_name>",
+    "Problem: <core_problem>",
+    "Business Model: <business_model>",
+    "",
+    "If this is correct, type the details below.",
+    "Otherwise, type your inputs manually.",
+    "",
+    "Product name:",
+    "Core problem:",
+    "Business model:",
+    "",
+    "Type 'done' to accept these defaults, or press enter for the typed path.",
+)
+
+HONESTY_CONTRACT_LINES: tuple[str, ...] = (
+    "(this is an experimental feature — no data is shared without your consent)",
+    "we don't publish dates or send reminders",
+    "open an issue if you have questions: https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi/issues",
+    "http://localhost:8000/mcp",  # MCP endpoint for maintainers",
+)
+
+
+# ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+__all__ = [
+    "PageSignals",
+    "infer_baseline",
+    "fetch_signals",
+    "CARD_LINES",
+    "HONESTY_CONTRACT_LINES",
+]
+
+
+def maybe_run_first_launch(
+    *, no_onboard: bool = False, invoked_subcommand: str | None = None
+) -> None:
+    """Skip first-run onboarding if conditions are met.
+
+    Conditions that skip onboarding:
+    - baseline already exists
+    - no TTY (non-interactive: not stdin.isatty() or not stdout.isatty())
+    - --no-onboard flag passed
+    - invoked Subcommand is one that should not trigger onboarding
+    """
+    if no_onboard:
+        return
+
+    if profile.baseline_exists():
+        return
+
+    # Non-interactive contexts skip the card
+    if not (sys.stdin.isatty() and sys.stdout.isatty()):
+        return
+
+    # Do not trigger onboarding for specific subcommands
+    if invoked_subcommand and invoked_subcommand in {"setup", "profile", "version", "help"}:
+        return
+
+    # Show the confirmation card (implementation-specific; this is a stub)
+    typer.echo("First-run onboarding card would appear here.")
+    typer.echo("".join(HONESTY_CONTRACT_LINES))

@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+"""Path resolution utilities for the agentic-odi CLI."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def install_root() -> Path:
+    """Resolve the installation root directory.
+
+    Resolution order:
+    1. AGENTIC_ODI_INSTALL_DIR env var
+    2. XDG_DATA_HOME/agentic-odi (POSIX) or %LOCALAPPDATA%\\agentic-odi (Windows)
+    3. ~/.local/share/agentic-odi (POSIX fallback)
+    """
+    env_install = os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_INSTALL_DIR")
+    if env_install:
+        return Path(env_install).resolve()
+
+    if sys.platform == "win32":
+        local_app_data = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA")
+        if local_app_data:
+            return Path(local_app_data) / "agentic-odi"
+        return Path.home() / "AppData" / "Local" / "agentic-odi"
+
+    xdg_data_home = os.environ.get("XDG_DATA_HOME")
+    if xdg_data_home:
+        return Path(xdg_data_home) / "agentic-odi"
+
+    return Path.home() / ".local" / "share" / "agentic-odi"
+
+
+def bin_dir() -> Path:
+    """Resolve the binary directory.
+
+    Resolution order:
+    1. XDG_BIN_HOME (POSIX) or install_root()/bin (Windows)
+    2. ~/.local/bin (POSIX fallback)
+    """
+    if sys.platform == "win32":
+        return install_root() / "bin"
+
+    xdg_bin_home = os.environ.get("XDG_BIN_HOME")
+    if xdg_bin_home:
+        return Path(xdg_bin_home)
+
+    return Path.home() / ".local" / "bin"
+
+
+def config_dir() -> Path:
+    """Resolve the configuration directory.
+
+    Resolution order:
+    1. XDG_CONFIG_HOME/agentic-odi (POSIX)
+    2. ~/.config/agentic-odi (POSIX fallback)
+    3. %APPDATA%\\agentic-odi (Windows)
+    """
+    if sys.platform == "win32":
+        app_data = os.environ.get("APPDATA")
+        if app_data:
+            return Path(app_data) / "agentic-odi"
+        return Path.home() / "AppData" / "Roaming" / "agentic-odi"
+
+    xdg_config_home = os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
+    if xdg_config_home:
+        return Path(xdg_config_home) / "agentic-odi"
+
+    return Path.home() / ".config" / "agentic-odi"
+
+
+def versions_dir() -> Path:
+    """Resolve the versions directory where installed versions are stored."""
+    return install_root() / "versions"
+
+
+def current_link() -> Path:
+    """Resolve the 'current' symlink path."""
+    return install_root() / "current"
+
+
+def state_file() -> Path:
+    """Resolve the update state file path."""
+    return install_root() / "update.json"
+
+
+def is_frozen() -> bool:
+    """Check if the application is running in a frozen/packaged state."""
+    return bool(getattr(sys, "frozen", False))
+
+
+def is_writable_dir(p: Path) -> bool:
+    """Check if the given path is a writable directory."""
+    try:
+        return p.is_dir() and os.access(p, os.W_OK)
+    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
+        return False

--- apps/cli/src/agentic_odi_cli/profile.py	
+++ apps/cli/src/agentic_odi_cli/profile.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,123 @@
+"""Profile model, XDG config path, atomic load/save, and `setup`/`profile` Typer sub-app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import typer
+
+app = typer.Typer(name="profile", help="Profile management commands")
+
+BASELINE_FILE_NAME = "baseline.json"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Baseline:
+    schema_version: int = 1
+    created_at: str | None = None
+    source: str | None = None
+    product_name: str | None = None
+    product_url: str | None = None
+    domain: str | None = None
+    primary_user: str | None = None
+    business_model: str | None = None
+    core_problem: str | None = None
+    current_focus: str | None = None
+    confidence: str | None = None
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
+        return {
+            "schema_version": self.schema_version,
+            "created_at": self.created_at,
+            "source": self.source,
+            "product_name": self.product_name,
+            "product_url": self.product_url,
+            "domain": self.domain,
+            "primary_user": self.primary_user,
+            "business_model": self.business_model,
+            "core_problem": self.core_problem,
+            "current_focus": self.current_focus,
+            "confidence": self.confidence,
+        }
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_dict(cls, d: dict) -> Baseline:
+        kwargs = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in cls.__dataclass_fields__}  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        return cls(**kwargs)
+
+
+def config_dir() -> Path:
+    """Return the XDG config dir for agentic-odi.
+
+    Uses XDG_CONFIG_HOME if set; otherwise falls back to HOME/agentic-odi.
+    """
+    xdg = os.getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
+    if xdg:
+        return Path(xdg) / "agentic-odi"
+    home = Path(os.getenv("HOME", ""))
+    return home / "agentic-odi"
+
+
+def baseline_file() -> Path:
+    """Return the path to the baseline JSON file."""
+    return config_dir() / BASELINE_FILE_NAME
+
+
+def baseline_exists() -> bool:
+    """Return True if the baseline file exists and is parseable."""
+    return baseline_file().exists()
+
+
+def load_baseline() -> Baseline | None:
+    """Load the baseline file, returning None if it does not exist.
+
+    Raises ValueError on unparseable JSON.
+    """
+    if not baseline_exists():
+        return None
+    try:
+        with open(baseline_file()) as f:
+            data = json.load(f)
+    except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as e:
+        raise ValueError(f"Failed to parse baseline file: {e}") from e
+    return Baseline.from_dict(data)
+
+
+def save_baseline(b: Baseline) -> Path:
+    """Save the baseline atomically, setting created_at ISO-8601 UTC when None."""
+    cfg_dir = config_dir()
+    cfg_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    b = (
+        b
+        if b.created_at is not None
+        else Baseline(
+            **{k: v for k, v in b.to_dict().items() if k != "created_at"},
+            created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
+        )
+    )
+    target = baseline_file()
+    tmp = target.with_name(target.name + ".tmp")
+    with open(tmp, "w") as f:
+        f.write(json.dumps(b.to_dict()))
+    os.replace(tmp, target)
+    return target
+
+
+def backup_baseline() -> Path | None:
+    """Copy the existing baseline file to a dated backup.
+
+    Returns the path of the backup file, or None if no existing file.
+    """
+    if not baseline_exists():
+        return None
+    import shutil
+
+    backup_path = baseline_file().with_name(
+        f"baseline.json.bak-{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}"
+    )
+    shutil.copy2(baseline_file(), backup_path)
+    return backup_path

--- apps/cli/src/agentic_odi_cli/render.py	
+++ apps/cli/src/agentic_odi_cli/render.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,113 @@
+"""Rendering helpers: human-readable by default, JSON on request.
+
+Every renderer takes ``as_json`` so the same command can serve a person at a
+terminal and a script piping into ``jq`` without a second code path.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from typing import Any
+
+_STATEMENT_WIDTH = 60
+
+
+def _json(payload: Any) -> str:
+    if isinstance(payload, str):
+        try:
+            payload = json.loads(payload)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            return payload
+    return json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
+
+
+def _truncate(text: str, width: int = _STATEMENT_WIDTH) -> str:
+    return text if len(text) <= width else text[: width - 1] + "…"
+
+
+def _num(value: Any) -> str:
+    """Render numeric scores to two decimals; pass anything else through."""
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return str(value)
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return f"{value:.2f}"
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def render_customer_outcome(outcome: Any, *, as_json: bool) -> str:
+    """Render one Customer Outcome as a labelled block or JSON."""
+    if not isinstance(outcome, dict):
+        return _json(outcome) if as_json else str(outcome)
+    if as_json:
+        return _json(outcome)
+
+    customer = outcome.get("customer_value", {})
+    business = outcome.get("business_value", {})
+    rows = [
+        ("id", outcome.get("id", "")),
+        ("job_id", outcome.get("job_id", "")),
+        ("statement", customer.get("statement", "")),
+        ("direction", customer.get("direction", "")),
+        ("unit", customer.get("unit_of_measure", "")),
+        ("object", customer.get("object_of_control", "")),
+        ("importance", _num(customer.get("importance", ""))),
+        ("satisfaction", _num(customer.get("satisfaction", ""))),
+        (
+            "opportunity",
+            _num(outcome.get("opportunity_score", customer.get("opportunity_score", ""))),
+        ),
+        ("category", business.get("category", "")),
+        ("business", business.get("statement", "")),
+    ]
+    width = max(len(label) for label, _ in rows)
+    return "\n".join(f"{label.ljust(width)}  {value}" for label, value in rows)
+
+
+def render_customer_outcome_list(outcomes: Any, *, as_json: bool) -> str:
+    """Render a Customer Outcome list as an aligned table or JSON."""
+    if not isinstance(outcomes, list):
+        return _json(outcomes) if as_json else str(outcomes)
+    if as_json:
+        return _json(outcomes)
+    if not outcomes:
+        return "No customer outcomes found."
+
+    headers = ("id", "statement", "importance", "satisfaction", "opportunity")
+    rows = [
+        (
+            str(item.get("id", "")),
+            _truncate(str(item.get("customer_value", {}).get("statement", ""))),
+            _num(item.get("customer_value", {}).get("importance", "")),
+            _num(item.get("customer_value", {}).get("satisfaction", "")),
+            _num(item.get("opportunity_score", "")),
+        )
+        for item in outcomes
+    ]
+    widths = [max(len(headers[i]), *(len(row[i]) for row in rows)) for i in range(len(headers))]
+    lines = ["  ".join(headers[i].ljust(widths[i]) for i in range(len(headers)))]
+    lines.append("  ".join("-" * widths[i] for i in range(len(headers))))
+    lines.extend("  ".join(row[i].ljust(widths[i]) for i in range(len(headers))) for row in rows)
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def render_saved(verb: str, outcome: Any, *, as_json: bool) -> str:
+    """Confirm a create/update, showing the outcome block by default."""
+    if not isinstance(outcome, dict):
+        return _json(outcome) if as_json else str(outcome)
+    if as_json:
+        return _json(outcome)
+    return f"Customer outcome {verb}: {outcome.get('id', '')}"
+
+
+def render_deleted(outcome_id: str, *, as_json: bool) -> str:
+    if as_json:
+        return _json({"id": outcome_id, "deleted": True})
+    return f"Deleted customer outcome: {outcome_id}"
+
+
+def render_score(importance: float, satisfaction: float, score: float, *, as_json: bool) -> str:
+    if as_json:
+        return _json(
+            {"importance": importance, "satisfaction": satisfaction, "opportunity_score": score}
+        )
+    return f"Opportunity score: {score:.2f}"

--- apps/cli/src/agentic_odi_cli/update.py	
+++ apps/cli/src/agentic_odi_cli/update.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,273 @@
+"""Self-update engine primitives (checksum, extraction, atomic version swap)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import platform
+import shutil
+import tarfile
+import tempfile
+import urllib.request
+import zipfile
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.parse import urlparse
+
+from agentic_odi_cli import paths
+from agentic_odi_cli.version import __version__
+
+RELEASES_API = "https://api.github.com/repos/alehar9320/agentic-odi/releases/latest"
+CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 86400
+_RELEASES_DOWNLOAD = "https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi/releases/download"
+
+_SYSTEM_MAP = {"Linux": "linux", "Darwin": "macos", "Windows": "windows"}
+_ARCH_MAP = {
+    "x86_64": "x86_64",
+    "AMD64": "x86_64",
+    "arm64": "arm64",
+    "aarch64": "arm64",
+}
+
+
+class UpdateError(Exception):
+    """Raised when an update cannot be performed."""
+
+
+def parse_version(s: str) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """Parse a version string into a ``(major, minor, patch)`` tuple."""
+    cleaned = s.strip().lstrip("v")
+    parts = cleaned.split(".")[:3]
+    nums = [int(p) for p in parts]
+    while len(nums) < 3:
+        nums.append(0)
+    return (nums[0], nums[1], nums[2])
+
+
+def is_newer(latest: str, current: str) -> bool:
+    """Return True if ``latest`` is strictly newer than ``current``."""
+    return parse_version(latest) > parse_version(current)
+
+
+def asset_name(version: str, os_name: str, arch: str) -> str:
+    """Return the release asset filename for a version/platform combination."""
+    ext = "zip" if os_name == "windows" else "tar.gz"
+    return f"odi_{version}_{os_name}_{arch}.{ext}"
+
+
+def current_platform() -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Map the running host to the release ``(os, arch)`` identifiers."""
+    os_name = _SYSTEM_MAP.get(platform.system(), platform.system().lower())
+    arch = _ARCH_MAP.get(platform.machine(), platform.machine().lower())
+    return os_name, arch
+
+
+def verify_checksum(path: Path, expected_hex: str) -> bool:
+    """Return True if the SHA-256 of ``path`` matches ``expected_hex``."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(65536), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest().lower() == expected_hex.strip().lower()
+
+
+def extract_archive(archive: Path, dest: Path) -> None:
+    """Extract ``archive`` (``.zip`` or ``.tar.gz``) into ``dest``."""
+    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if archive.name.endswith(".zip"):
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
+            zf.extractall(dest)  # nosec B202 - ZipFile strips absolute/'..' member paths
+    else:
+        with tarfile.open(archive, "r:gz") as tf:
+            tf.extractall(dest, filter="data")
+
+
+def _acquire_lock(install_root: Path) -> tuple[int, Path]:
+    lock_path = install_root / ".update.lock"
+    try:
+        fd = os.open(lock_path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
+    except FileExistsError as exc:
+        raise UpdateError("update already in progress") from exc
+    return fd, lock_path
+
+
+def _activate_version(version_dir: Path, install_root: Path) -> None:
+    current = install_root / "current"
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        marker_tmp = install_root / "current.tmp"
+        if marker_tmp.exists() or marker_tmp.is_symlink():
+            marker_tmp.unlink()
+        marker_tmp.write_text(str(version_dir))
+        os.replace(marker_tmp, current)
+        return
+
+    tmp_link = install_root / "current.tmp"
+    if tmp_link.is_symlink() or tmp_link.exists():
+        tmp_link.unlink()
+    os.symlink(version_dir, tmp_link)
+    os.replace(tmp_link, current)
+
+
+def perform_update(
+    version: str,
+    archive_path: Path,
+    expected_sha: str,
+    install_root: Path,
+) -> Path:
+    """Verify, extract, and atomically activate ``version``; return its dir."""
+    install_root = Path(install_root)
+    versions = install_root / "versions"
+    versions.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    lock_fd, lock_path = _acquire_lock(install_root)
+    try:
+        if not verify_checksum(archive_path, expected_sha):
+            raise UpdateError(f"checksum mismatch for {archive_path.name}")
+
+        tmp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".extract-", dir=versions))
+        final_dir = versions / version
+        try:
+            extract_archive(archive_path, tmp_dir)
+            if final_dir.is_symlink() or final_dir.is_file():
+                final_dir.unlink()
+            elif final_dir.is_dir():
+                shutil.rmtree(final_dir)
+            os.replace(tmp_dir, final_dir)
+        except BaseException:
+            shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
+            raise
+
+        _activate_version(final_dir, install_root)
+        return final_dir
+    finally:
+        os.close(lock_fd)
+        try:
+            lock_path.unlink()
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            pass
+
+
+def should_check(state_file: Path, now: float) -> bool:
+    """Return True if an update check is due (missing/corrupt state ⇒ due)."""
+    try:
+        data = json.loads(Path(state_file).read_text())
+        last_check = float(data["last_check"])
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
+        return True
+    return (now - last_check) >= CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS
+
+
+def record_check(state_file: Path, now: float) -> None:
+    """Persist the timestamp of the most recent check."""
+    path = Path(state_file)
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({"last_check": now}))
+
+
+def _require_https(url: str) -> None:
+    """Reject anything that is not plain HTTPS before it can be opened."""
+    if urlparse(url).scheme != "https":
+        raise UpdateError(f"refusing non-HTTPS URL: {url}")
+
+
+def _default_fetch(url: str) -> str:
+    _require_https(url)
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=10) as response:  # nosec B310 - _require_https
+        return response.read().decode("utf-8")
+
+
+def _default_fetch_bytes(url: str) -> bytes:
+    _require_https(url)
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=10) as response:  # nosec B310 - _require_https
+        return response.read()
+
+
+def latest_release(current: str, *, fetch: Callable[[str], str] | None = None) -> str | None:
+    """Return the latest release version if newer than ``current``, else None."""
+    fetcher = fetch if fetch is not None else _default_fetch
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(fetcher(RELEASES_API))
+        tag = str(payload["tag_name"]).strip()
+    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
+        return None
+    latest = tag.lstrip("v")
+    if is_newer(latest, current):
+        return latest
+    return None
+
+
+def _parse_checksums(text: str, filename: str) -> str | None:
+    """Return the SHA-256 hex for ``filename`` from a sha256sum-format body."""
+    for line in text.splitlines():
+        parts = line.split()
+        if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[1] == filename:
+            return parts[0]
+    return None
+
+
+def download(
+    version: str,
+    dest_dir: Path,
+    *,
+    fetch_bytes: Callable[[str], bytes] | None = None,
+) -> Path:
+    """Download and verify the release archive for ``version``."""
+    fetcher = fetch_bytes if fetch_bytes is not None else _default_fetch_bytes
+    base = f"{_RELEASES_DOWNLOAD}/v{version}"
+    asset = asset_name(version, *current_platform())
+
+    try:
+        checksums = fetcher(f"{base}/checksums.txt").decode("utf-8")
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+        raise UpdateError(f"failed to fetch checksums.txt: {exc}") from exc
+
+    expected = _parse_checksums(checksums, asset)
+    if expected is None:
+        raise UpdateError(f"no checksum entry for {asset}")
+
+    try:
+        payload = fetcher(f"{base}/{asset}")
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+        raise UpdateError(f"failed to fetch {asset}: {exc}") from exc
+
+    dest_dir = Path(dest_dir)
+    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    dest = dest_dir / asset
+    dest.write_bytes(payload)
+    if not verify_checksum(dest, expected):
+        raise UpdateError(f"checksum mismatch for {asset}")
+    return dest
+
+
+def auto_update_enabled(no_update: bool) -> bool:
+    """Return whether auto-update is enabled by the flag/env opt-outs."""
+    return (not no_update) and (not os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_NO_UPDATE"))
+
+
+def maybe_auto_update(*, no_update: bool, now: float) -> str | None:
+    """Best-effort background update; never raises, returns new version or None."""
+    try:
+        if not auto_update_enabled(no_update):
+            return None
+        root = paths.install_root()
+        if not paths.is_frozen():
+            return None
+        if not paths.is_writable_dir(root):
+            return None
+        if (root / ".update.lock").exists():
+            return None
+        state = paths.state_file()
+        if not should_check(state, now):
+            return None
+        record_check(state, now)
+        version = latest_release(__version__)
+        if version is None:
+            return None
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="odi-update-") as tmp:
+            archive = download(version, Path(tmp))
+            digest = hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+            perform_update(version, archive, digest, root)
+        return version
+    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
+        return None

+    return f"{build_summary()}\ncommit: {COMMIT}\ntarget: {TARGET}"

+"""Backend seam: local SQLite backend and remote MCP backend."""

+    _to_openai_tools,
+    handle_command,
+)
+from agentic_odi_cli.cli import app
+from typer.testing import CliRunner
+
+ANSI_ESCAPE = re.compile(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*m")
+
+
+def _strip_ansi(text: str) -> str:
+    return ANSI_ESCAPE.sub("", text)
+
+
+def _config() -> ChatConfig:
+    return ChatConfig(
+        base_url="http://localhost:8001/v1",
+        api_key="local",
+        model="test-model",
+        mcp_url="http://localhost:8000/mcp",
+    )
+
+
+class _FakeSession:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.tool_names = ["add_job", "get_jobs"]
+        self.cleared = False
+
+    def clear(self) -> None:
+        self.cleared = True
+
+
+class _FakeStream:
+    def __init__(self, chunks: list[Any]) -> None:
+        self._chunks = list(chunks)
+
+    def __aiter__(self) -> _FakeStream:
+        return self
+
+    async def __anext__(self) -> Any:
+        if not self._chunks:
+            raise StopAsyncIteration
+        return self._chunks.pop(0)
+
+
+class _FakeCompletions:
+    def __init__(self, streams: list[_FakeStream]) -> None:
+        self._streams = list(streams)
+        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    async def create(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _FakeStream:
+        self.calls.append(kwargs)
+        return self._streams.pop(0)
+
+
+class _FakeMCP:
+    def __init__(self, tools: list[Any], results: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+        self._tools = tools
+        self._results = results
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]] = []
+
+    async def list_tools(self) -> list[Any]:
+        return self._tools
+
+    async def call_tool(self, name: str, arguments: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
+        self.calls.append((name, arguments))
+        return SimpleNamespace(content=[SimpleNamespace(text=self._results[name])])
+
+
+def _chunk(content: str | None = None, tool_calls: list[Any] | None = None) -> Any:
+    delta = SimpleNamespace(content=content, tool_calls=tool_calls)
+    return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(delta=delta)])
+
+
+def _make_session(
+    streams: list[_FakeStream], tools: list[Any], results: dict[str, str]
+) -> tuple[ChatSession, _FakeCompletions, _FakeMCP]:
+    completions = _FakeCompletions(streams)
+    openai_client = SimpleNamespace(chat=SimpleNamespace(completions=completions))
+    mcp = _FakeMCP(tools, results)
+    session = ChatSession(_config(), openai_client, mcp)
+    return session, completions, mcp
+
+

+    monkeypatch.setenv("AGENTIC_ODI_MODEL", "custom-model")

+    assert config.model == "from-flag"

+
+def test_handle_command_routes_and_clears(capsys) -> None:
+    session = _FakeSession()
+
+    assert handle_command("hello", session) is None
+    assert handle_command("/exit", session) == "exit"
+    assert handle_command("/quit", session) == "exit"
+    assert handle_command("/help", session) == "handled"

+"""Runtime tests for the interactive chat loop and command handlers."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+import typer
+from agentic_odi_cli import chat
+
+
+def _config() -> chat.ChatConfig:
+    return chat.ChatConfig(
+        base_url="http://localhost:8001/v1",
+        api_key="local",
+        model="test-model",
+        mcp_url="http://localhost:8000/mcp",
+    )
+
+
+def _chunk(content: str | None = None, tool_calls: list[Any] | None = None) -> Any:
+    delta = SimpleNamespace(content=content, tool_calls=tool_calls)
+    return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(delta=delta)])
+
+
+class _FakeStream:
+    def __init__(self, chunks: list[Any]) -> None:
+        self._chunks = list(chunks)
+
+    def __aiter__(self) -> _FakeStream:
+        return self
+
+    async def __anext__(self) -> Any:
+        if not self._chunks:
+            raise StopAsyncIteration
+        return self._chunks.pop(0)
+
+
+class _Completions:
+    def __init__(
+        self, streams: list[_FakeStream] | None = None, error: Exception | None = None
+    ) -> None:
+        self._streams = list(streams or [])
+        self._error = error
+
+    async def create(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _FakeStream:
+        if self._error is not None:
+            raise self._error
+        return self._streams.pop(0)
+
+
+class _FakeLLM:
+    instances: list[_FakeLLM] = []
+
+    def __init__(self, streams, error=None, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
+        self.chat = SimpleNamespace(completions=_Completions(streams, error))
+        self.closed = False
+        _FakeLLM.instances.append(self)
+
+    async def close(self) -> None:
+        self.closed = True
+
+
+class _FakeMCP:
+    def __init__(self, tools: list[Any] | None = None, fail_list: bool = False) -> None:
+        self._tools = tools or []
+        self._fail_list = fail_list
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]] = []
+
+    async def __aenter__(self) -> _FakeMCP:
+        return self
+
+    async def __aexit__(self, *exc: Any) -> bool:
+        return False
+
+    async def list_tools(self) -> list[Any]:
+        if self._fail_list:
+            raise RuntimeError("no tools")
+        return self._tools
+
+    async def call_tool(self, name: str, arguments: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
+        self.calls.append((name, arguments))
+        return SimpleNamespace(content=[SimpleNamespace(text="ok")])
+
+
+def _tool(name: str = "get_jobs") -> Any:
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        name=name,
+        description="List jobs",
+        input_schema={"type": "object", "properties": {}},
+    )
+
+
+def _inputs(values: list[Any]):
+    iterator = iter(values)
+
+    def _input(prompt: str = "") -> str:
+        value = next(iterator)
+        if isinstance(value, BaseException):
+            raise value
+        return value
+
+    return _input
+
+
+def _install(
+    monkeypatch,
+    *,
+    inputs: list[Any],
+    streams: list[_FakeStream] | None = None,
+    error: Exception | None = None,
+    mcp: _FakeMCP | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    _FakeLLM.instances = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(chat, "Client", lambda url: mcp or _FakeMCP([_tool()]))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(chat, "AsyncOpenAI", lambda **kwargs: _FakeLLM(streams, error, **kwargs))
+    monkeypatch.setattr("builtins.input", _inputs(inputs))
+
+
+def test_run_chat_streams_a_reply_and_says_goodbye(monkeypatch, capsys) -> None:

+    assert "Goodbye." in output

+"""Guard against importing heavy dependencies at CLI module load time.
+
+``agentic-odi --version`` and ``--help`` must not pull in the MCP client,
+the connectors package, or the core domain layer just to run.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+_HEAVY_MODULES = ("fastmcp", "agentic_odi_connectors", "agentic_odi_core", "openai")
+
+
+def test_importing_cli_entrypoint_does_not_load_heavy_modules():
+    code = (
+        "import sys; import agentic_odi_cli.cli; "
+        "print(','.join(m for m in "
+        f"{list(_HEAVY_MODULES)!r} if m in sys.modules))"
+    )
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-c", code],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=True,
+    )
+    loaded = [name for name in result.stdout.strip().split(",") if name]
+    assert loaded == [], f"heavy modules imported at load time: {loaded}"

+    assert update.maybe_auto_update(no_update=False, now=1001.0) is None
+
+
+def test_maybe_auto_update_swallows_failures(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch) -> None:
+    root = tmp_path / "install"
+    root.mkdir()
+    _auto_update_paths(monkeypatch, root)
+
+    def _boom(current: str) -> str:

+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(update, "latest_release", _boom)

+    assert update.maybe_auto_update(no_update=False, now=1000.0) is None

@@ -0,0 +1,259 @@
+"""Agentic ODI MCP Server (FastMCP)."""
+
+import json
+from typing import Any
+
+from agentic_odi_core import (
+    CAPABILITIES,
+    ODI_ASSISTANT_PROMPT,
+    ODI_FRAMEWORK_GUIDELINES,
+    CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError,
+    ODIService,
+    ValueOutOfRangeError,
+    compute_opportunity_score,
+)
+from agentic_odi_core import (
+    customer_outcome_not_found as _cust_not_found,
+)
+from agentic_odi_core.repository import InMemoryRepository, Repository
+from agentic_odi_core.sqlite_repository import SQLiteRepository
+from fastmcp import FastMCP
+from pydantic import ValidationError
+
+mcp = FastMCP("Agentic ODI")
+
+_repo: Repository = InMemoryRepository()
+service = ODIService(_repo)
+
+jobs_db = _repo.jobs
+steps_db = _repo.steps
+outcomes_db = _repo.outcomes
+customer_outcomes_db = _repo.customer_outcomes
+
+
+def configure(repo: Repository) -> None:
+    """Point every tool at ``repo``.
+
+    The module-level server starts with an in-memory repository so tests stay
+    fast and isolated. The production entry point (:func:`main`) calls this with
+    a SQLite repository before serving requests.
+    """
+    global _repo, service, jobs_db, steps_db, outcomes_db, customer_outcomes_db
+    _repo = repo
+    service = ODIService(repo)
+    jobs_db = getattr(repo, "jobs", {})
+    steps_db = getattr(repo, "steps", {})
+    outcomes_db = getattr(repo, "outcomes", {})
+    customer_outcomes_db = getattr(repo, "customer_outcomes", {})
+
+
+@mcp.prompt
+def odi_assistant_prompt() -> str:
+    return ODI_ASSISTANT_PROMPT
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def add_job(name: str, description: str | None = None) -> str:
+    job = service.add_job(name=name, description=description)
+    return f"Job created successfully: {job.model_dump_json()}"
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def get_jobs() -> str:
+    jobs = service.get_jobs()
+    return json.dumps([job.model_dump() for job in jobs])
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def get_job(job_id: str) -> str:
+    job = service.get_job(job_id)
+    if not job:
+        return f"Error: Job with ID {job_id} not found."
+    return job.model_dump_json()
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def add_step(job_id: str, name: str, order: int) -> str:
+    step = service.add_step(job_id=job_id, name=name, order=order)
+    return f"Step created successfully: {step.model_dump_json()}"
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def get_job_map(job_id: str) -> str:
+    job = service.get_job(job_id)
+    if not job:
+        return f"Error: Job with ID {job_id} not found."
+    steps = service.get_job_map(job_id)
+    return json.dumps([step.model_dump() for step in steps])
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def add_outcome(
+    job_id: str,
+    statement: str,
+    importance: float | None = None,
+    satisfaction: float | None = None,
+    step_id: str | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    job = service.get_job(job_id)
+    if not job:
+        return f"Error: Job with ID {job_id} not found."
+    try:
+        outcome = service.add_outcome(
+            job_id=job_id,
+            statement=statement,
+            importance=importance,
+            satisfaction=satisfaction,
+            step_id=step_id,
+        )
+    except ValueOutOfRangeError:
+        return "Error: importance and satisfaction must be between 1.0 and 10.0"
+    return f"Outcome created successfully: {outcome.model_dump_json()}"
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def get_outcomes(job_id: str, step_id: str | None = None) -> str:
+    job = service.get_job(job_id)
+    if not job:
+        return f"Error: Job with ID {job_id} not found."
+    outcomes = service.get_outcomes(job_id=job_id, step_id=step_id)
+    return json.dumps([outcome.model_dump() for outcome in outcomes])
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def add_customer_outcome(
+    job_id: str,
+    customer_value: dict[str, Any],
+    business_value: dict[str, Any],
+    step_id: str | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    job = service.get_job(job_id)
+    if not job:
+        return f"Error: Job with ID {job_id} not found."
+    try:
+        co = service.add_customer_outcome(
+            job_id=job_id,
+            customer_value=customer_value,
+            business_value=business_value,
+            step_id=step_id,
+        )
+    except ValidationError as e:
+        return f"Error: {e}"
+    return f"Customer outcome created successfully: {co.model_dump_json()}"
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def get_customer_outcome(outcome_id: str) -> str:
+    try:
+        co = service.get_customer_outcome(outcome_id)
+    except CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError:
+        return _cust_not_found(outcome_id)
+    return co.model_dump_json()
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def list_customer_outcomes(job_id: str | None = None) -> str:
+    outcomes = service.list_customer_outcomes(job_id=job_id)
+    return json.dumps([o.model_dump() for o in outcomes])
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def update_customer_outcome(
+    outcome_id: str,
+    direction: str | None = None,
+    unit_of_measure: str | None = None,
+    object_of_control: str | None = None,
+    contextual_clarifier: str | None = None,
+    statement: str | None = None,
+    importance: float | None = None,
+    satisfaction: float | None = None,
+    category: str | None = None,
+    business_statement: str | None = None,
+    detail: str | None = None,
+    estimated_annual_value: float | None = None,
+    confidence: float | None = None,
+    step_id: str | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    try:
+        co = service.get_customer_outcome(outcome_id)
+    except CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError:
+        return _cust_not_found(outcome_id)
+    updates: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    cv_d = co.customer_value.model_dump()
+    if direction is not None:
+        cv_d["direction"] = direction
+    if unit_of_measure is not None:
+        cv_d["unit_of_measure"] = unit_of_measure
+    if object_of_control is not None:
+        cv_d["object_of_control"] = object_of_control
+    if contextual_clarifier is not None:
+        cv_d["contextual_clarifier"] = contextual_clarifier
+    if statement is not None:
+        cv_d["statement"] = statement
+    if importance is not None:
+        cv_d["importance"] = importance
+    if satisfaction is not None:
+        cv_d["satisfaction"] = satisfaction
+    updates["customer_value"] = cv_d
+    bv_d = co.business_value.model_dump()
+    if category is not None:
+        bv_d["category"] = category
+    if business_statement is not None:
+        bv_d["statement"] = business_statement
+    if detail is not None:
+        bv_d["detail"] = detail
+    if estimated_annual_value is not None:
+        bv_d["estimated_annual_value"] = estimated_annual_value
+    if confidence is not None:
+        bv_d["confidence"] = confidence
+    updates["business_value"] = bv_d
+    if step_id is not None:
+        updates["step_id"] = step_id
+    try:
+        co2 = service.update_customer_outcome(outcome_id, updates)
+    except CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError:
+        return _cust_not_found(outcome_id)
+    except ValidationError as e:
+        return f"Error: {e}"
+    return f"Customer outcome updated successfully: {co2.model_dump_json()}"
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def delete_customer_outcome(outcome_id: str) -> str:
+    try:
+        service.delete_customer_outcome(outcome_id)
+    except CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError:
+        return _cust_not_found(outcome_id)
+    return f"Customer outcome deleted successfully: {outcome_id}"
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def compute_opportunity(importance: float, satisfaction: float) -> str:
+    if not (1.0 <= importance <= 10.0) or not (1.0 <= satisfaction <= 10.0):
+        return "Error: importance and satisfaction must be between 1.0 and 10.0"
+    score = compute_opportunity_score(importance, satisfaction)
+    return f"Opportunity score: {score:.2f}"
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def get_odi_framework_guidelines() -> str:
+    return ODI_FRAMEWORK_GUIDELINES
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def get_capabilities() -> str:
+    return CAPABILITIES
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    configure(SQLiteRepository())
+    mcp.run(transport="http", port=8000)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+
+
+@mcp.tool
+def greet(name: str) -> str:
+    return f"Hello, {name}!"

+import json
+import re
+
+import pytest
+from agentic_odi_mcp_server import jobs_db, mcp
+from fastmcp import Client
+
+
+def extract_id(result_str):
+    match = re.search(r'"id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', result_str)
+    return match.group(1) if match else None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_odi_workflow():
+    """Test the full ODI workflow (Add Job -> Add Steps -> Add Outcome -> Get Data)."""
+    # Use in-memory testing by passing the server instance directly to the client
+    async with Client(mcp) as client:
+        # 1. Add a Job
+        job_result = await client.call_tool(
+            "add_job", {"name": "Listen to music", "description": "Listen to music on the go"}
+        )
+        job_text = job_result.content[0].text
+        assert "Job created successfully" in job_text
+
+        job_id = extract_id(job_text)
+        assert job_id in jobs_db
+
+        # 2. Add Steps to the Job Map
+        step1_res = await client.call_tool(
+            "add_step", {"job_id": job_id, "name": "Select music", "order": 1}
+        )
+        step2_res = await client.call_tool(
+            "add_step", {"job_id": job_id, "name": "Play music", "order": 2}
+        )
+
+        step1_text = step1_res.content[0].text
+        assert "Step created successfully" in step1_text
+        assert "Step created successfully" in step2_res.content[0].text
+
+        step1_id = extract_id(step1_text)
+
+        # 3. Add an Outcome
+        outcome_res = await client.call_tool(
+            "add_outcome",
+            {
+                "job_id": job_id,
+                "statement": "Minimize the time it takes to find a specific song",
+                "importance": 8.5,
+                "satisfaction": 4.0,
+                "step_id": step1_id,
+            },
+        )
+        outcome_text = outcome_res.content[0].text
+        assert "Outcome created successfully" in outcome_text
+
+        outcome_match = re.search(r"({.*})", outcome_text, re.DOTALL)
+        outcome_data = json.loads(outcome_match.group(1)) if outcome_match else {}
+
+        # Check that opportunity score was calculated correctly: 8.5 + max(8.5 - 4.0, 0) = 8.5 + 4.5 = 13.0
+        assert outcome_data.get("opportunity_score") == 13.0
+
+        # 4. Retrieve Data
+        job_map_res = await client.call_tool("get_job_map", {"job_id": job_id})
+        job_map_text = job_map_res.content[0].text
+        job_map_match = re.search(r"(\[.*\])", job_map_text, re.DOTALL)
+        job_map_data = json.loads(job_map_match.group(1)) if job_map_match else []
+
+        assert len(job_map_data) == 2
+        assert job_map_data[0]["name"] == "Select music"
+        assert job_map_data[1]["name"] == "Play music"
+
+        outcomes_res = await client.call_tool("get_outcomes", {"job_id": job_id})
+        outcomes_text = outcomes_res.content[0].text
+        outcomes_match = re.search(r"(\[.*\])", outcomes_text, re.DOTALL)
+        outcomes_data = json.loads(outcomes_match.group(1)) if outcomes_match else []
+        assert len(outcomes_data) == 1
+        assert outcomes_data[0]["statement"] == "Minimize the time it takes to find a specific song"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_get_capabilities():
+    """Test that the get_capabilities tool returns the expected human-readable markdown string."""
+    async with Client(mcp) as client:
+        result = await client.call_tool("get_capabilities", {})
+        result_text = result.content[0].text if hasattr(result, "content") else str(result)
+
+        # Check that it returns a string with the expected categories
+        assert "Here is what I can help you with" in result_text
+        assert "Manage Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD)" in result_text
+        assert "Build Job Maps" in result_text
+        assert "Track Desired Outcomes" in result_text

+"""Branch coverage for MCP tool prompts, errors, and full updates."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import re
+
+import pytest
+from agentic_odi_mcp_server import mcp
+from agentic_odi_mcp_server import mcp_server as server
+from fastmcp import Client
+from mcp.types import TextContent
+
+
+def _text(result) -> str:
+    content = result.content[0]
+    assert isinstance(content, TextContent)
+    return content.text
+
+
+def _extract_id(text: str) -> str:
+    match = re.search(r'"id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', text)
+    assert match is not None
+    return match.group(1)
+
+
+def _payload(text: str) -> dict:
+    match = re.search(r"({.*})", text, re.DOTALL)
+    assert match is not None
+    return json.loads(match.group(1))
+
+
+def _customer_value() -> dict:
+    return {
+        "direction": "minimize",
+        "unit_of_measure": "time",
+        "object_of_control": "to resolve setup errors",
+        "statement": "Minimize the time to resolve setup errors",
+        "importance": 8.5,
+        "satisfaction": 3.5,
+    }
+
+
+def _business_value() -> dict:
+    return {"category": "cost_reduction", "statement": "Saves engineering hours"}
+
+
+async def _create_customer_outcome(client: Client) -> str:
+    await client.call_tool("add_job", {"name": "Onboard"})
+    jobs = json.loads(_text(await client.call_tool("get_jobs", {})))
+    job_id = jobs[0]["id"]
+    result = await client.call_tool(
+        "add_customer_outcome",
+        {
+            "job_id": job_id,
+            "customer_value": _customer_value(),
+            "business_value": _business_value(),
+        },
+    )
+    return _extract_id(_text(result))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_assistant_prompt_is_registered() -> None:
+    async with Client(mcp) as client:
+        prompts = await client.list_prompts()
+        result = await client.get_prompt("odi_assistant_prompt")
+
+    assert [prompt.name for prompt in prompts] == ["odi_assistant_prompt"]
+    assert getattr(result.messages[0].content, "text", None) == server.ODI_ASSISTANT_PROMPT
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_add_outcome_rejects_out_of_range_scores() -> None:
+    async with Client(mcp) as client:
+        await client.call_tool("add_job", {"name": "Onboard"})

+
+        result = await client.call_tool(
+            "add_outcome",
+            {
+                "job_id": jobs[0]["id"],
+                "statement": "Minimize onboarding time",
+                "importance": 11.0,
+                "satisfaction": 5.0,
+            },

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_add_customer_outcome_reports_validation_errors() -> None:
+    async with Client(mcp) as client:
+        await client.call_tool("add_job", {"name": "Onboard"})

+@pytest.mark.asyncio

+            "update_customer_outcome", {"outcome_id": "missing", "importance": 9.0}
+        )

+    assert _text(result) == "Customer outcome not found: missing"

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_update_customer_outcome_applies_every_field() -> None:
+    async with Client(mcp) as client:
+        outcome_id = await _create_customer_outcome(client)
+
+        result = await client.call_tool(
+            "update_customer_outcome",
+            {
+                "outcome_id": outcome_id,
+                "direction": "maximize",
+                "unit_of_measure": "hours",
+                "object_of_control": "throughput",
+                "contextual_clarifier": "during onboarding",
+                "statement": "Maximize onboarding throughput",
+                "importance": 9.0,
+                "satisfaction": 2.0,
+                "category": "retention",
+                "business_statement": "Keeps customers",
+                "detail": "Expansion revenue",
+                "estimated_annual_value": 120000.0,
+                "confidence": 0.8,
+                "step_id": "step-1",
+            },
+        )
+
+    data = _payload(_text(result))
+    assert data["customer_value"]["direction"] == "maximize"
+    assert data["customer_value"]["unit_of_measure"] == "hours"
+    assert data["customer_value"]["object_of_control"] == "throughput"
+    assert data["customer_value"]["contextual_clarifier"] == "during onboarding"
+    assert data["customer_value"]["statement"] == "Maximize onboarding throughput"
+    assert data["customer_value"]["importance"] == 9.0
+    assert data["customer_value"]["satisfaction"] == 2.0
+    assert data["business_value"]["category"] == "retention"
+    assert data["business_value"]["statement"] == "Keeps customers"
+    assert data["business_value"]["detail"] == "Expansion revenue"
+    assert data["business_value"]["estimated_annual_value"] == 120000.0
+    assert data["business_value"]["confidence"] == 0.8
+    assert data["step_id"] == "step-1"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_update_customer_outcome_reports_validation_errors() -> None:
+    async with Client(mcp) as client:
+        outcome_id = await _create_customer_outcome(client)
+
+        result = await client.call_tool(
+            "update_customer_outcome",
+            {"outcome_id": outcome_id, "category": "not-a-category"},

+    assert _text(result).startswith("Error: ")
+

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_delete_customer_outcome_reports_missing_ids() -> None:
+    async with Client(mcp) as client:
+        result = await client.call_tool("delete_customer_outcome", {"outcome_id": "missing"})
+
+    assert _text(result) == "Customer outcome not found: missing"
+
+
+def test_main_runs_the_http_transport(monkeypatch) -> None:
+    calls: list[dict] = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mcp, "run", lambda **kwargs: calls.append(kwargs))
+
+    server.main()
+
+    assert calls == [{"transport": "http", "port": 8000}]

+"""FastAPI app for the Living Studio sidecar."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from agentic_odi_core import ODIService
+from agentic_odi_core.repository import Repository
+from agentic_odi_core.sqlite_repository import SQLiteRepository
+from fastapi import FastAPI
+from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
+from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse
+from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
+
+from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.router import router as studio_router
+
+CORS_ORIGINS = [
+    "tauri://localhost",
+    "http://tauri.localhost",
+    "http://localhost:5173",
+    "http://127.0.0.1:5173",
+    "http://localhost:8100",
+    "http://127.0.0.1:8100",
+]
+
+DEFAULT_BACKEND = "local"
+
+
+def default_spa_dist() -> Path:
+    """Resolve the built SPA, preferring an explicit override."""
+    configured = os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_STUDIO_DIST")
+    if configured:
+        return Path(configured)
+    return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "apps" / "studio" / "dist"
+
+
+SPA_DIST = default_spa_dist()
+
+
+def create_app(repo: Repository | None = None, backend: str | None = None) -> FastAPI:
+    if repo is None:
+        repo = SQLiteRepository()
+    service = ODIService(repo)
+    app = FastAPI(title="Agentic ODI Studio API")
+    app.state.service = service
+    app.state.backend = backend or os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_BACKEND") or DEFAULT_BACKEND
+
+    app.add_middleware(
+        CORSMiddleware,
+        allow_origins=CORS_ORIGINS,
+        allow_credentials=False,
+        allow_methods=["*"],
+        allow_headers=["*"],
+    )
+
+    @app.get("/health")
+    def health() -> dict:
+        return {"status": "ok"}
+
+    @app.get("/capabilities")
+    def capabilities() -> dict:
+        return {"capabilities": app.state.backend}
+
+    app.include_router(studio_router)
+
+    if SPA_DIST.is_dir() and not os.getenv("AGENTIC_ODI_DISABLE_SPA"):
+        assets_dir = SPA_DIST / "assets"
+        if assets_dir.is_dir():
+            app.mount("/assets", StaticFiles(directory=assets_dir), name="assets")
+
+        @app.get("/{full_path:path}", response_model=None)
+        def spa_fallback(full_path: str) -> FileResponse | JSONResponse:
+            candidate = (SPA_DIST / full_path).resolve()
+            if full_path and candidate.is_file() and candidate.is_relative_to(SPA_DIST.resolve()):
+                return FileResponse(candidate)
+            index = SPA_DIST / "index.html"
+            if index.is_file():
+                return FileResponse(index)
+            return JSONResponse({"detail": "Not Found"}, status_code=404)
+
+    return app

+"""Conversational helper with offline fallbacks and a streaming tool loop.
+
+Ported 1:1 from the Streamlit Living Studio app, upgraded to stream over SSE.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
+from typing import Any
+
+from fastmcp import Client as McpClient
+from openai import AsyncOpenAI
+
+from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.probes import check_llm_health
+from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.schemas import ChatRequest
+
+SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are Steve Jobs and an elite Outcome-Driven Innovation (ODI) strategist assisting a Product Manager in The Living Studio.
+Your mission is to eliminate backlog paper-pushing and help the PM think exclusively in human intent, customer friction, and measurable outcomes.
+Key principles:
+1. Always start with the Job-to-be-Done (JTBD): "What is the core functional human job?"
+2. Uncover Desired Outcomes using the strict ODI format: [Direction] + [Unit of Measure] + [Object of Control] + [Contextual Clarifier]. (e.g. "Minimize the time it takes to propagate secrets across environments").
+3. Opportunity Score = Importance + max(Importance - Satisfaction, 0). Scores > 10 represent breakthrough underserved market opportunities.
+4. When asked to add or query Jobs, Steps, or Outcomes, ALWAYS invoke the corresponding tools.
+5. Embody clarity, focus, and causality. Strip away corporate jargon."""
+
+
+def offline_fallback(user_input: str) -> str:
+    """Intelligent grounded fallback when no LLM backend is reachable."""
+    lower_inp = user_input.lower()
+    if "guideline" in lower_inp or "framework" in lower_inp or "stage" in lower_inp:
+        return (
+            "### 📖 Outcome-Driven Innovation (ODI) Process Guidelines\n\n"
+            "1. **Stage 1: Define Intent (Job-to-be-Done)** — Identify the core functional human goal.\n"
+            "2. **Stage 2: Capture Desired Outcomes** — Success metrics: `[Direction] + [Unit] + [Object] + [Context]`.\n"
+            "3. **Stage 3: Opportunity Scoring** — `Importance + max(Importance - Satisfaction, 0)`. Focus on scores > 10.\n"
+            "4. **Stage 4: Universal Job Map** — Map the 8 stages: Define ➔ Locate ➔ Prepare ➔ Confirm ➔ Execute ➔ Monitor ➔ Modify ➔ Conclude.\n\n"
+            "*(Connected in Local Studio Mode. Start your local LLM backend at `http://localhost:8001/v1` for full autonomous completions)*"
+        )
+    if "simulate" in lower_inp or "bet" in lower_inp or "impact" in lower_inp:
+        return (
+            "### ⚡ WYSIWYG Impact Simulation Result\n\n"
+            "- **Target Outcome**: O-1 (*Minimize time taken to propagate secrets*)\n"
+            "- **Proposed Bet**: Automated Secret Sync Daemon\n"
+            "- **Before**: 45 minutes of manual copy-paste across 400 developer pipelines.\n"
+            "- **After**: Under 30 seconds ambient zero-touch sync.\n"
+            "- **Time-to-Value Shift**: **-90% friction reduction**.\n"
+            "- **Human Impact**: 3,000 hours of developer agony eliminated every month. Build it."
+        )
+    if "evidence" in lower_inp or "call" in lower_inp or "quote" in lower_inp:
+        return (
+            "### 🔍 Causal Lineage: Real-Time Evidence\n\n"
+            "- **Signal Source**: Gong Call #104 (Enterprise Team Alpha)\n"
+            "- **Customer Voice**: *'We lost two hours on deploy day because someone missed a database config key.'*\n"
+            "- **Telemetry**: 400 microservices impacted weekly; 14% failed build rate attributed to config drift."
+        )
+    return (
+        f'I received your intent: **"{user_input}"**.\n\n'
+        "In The Living Studio, every idea is evaluated against human outcomes rather than story points. "
+        "Notice how our highest opportunity outcome (`O-1: Minimize propagation time`) has an **Opportunity Score of 15.3**, "
+        "signaling severe market underservice. Tap **'Simulate Impact'** on the canvas or type `Simulate Auto-Sync Bet` to test causality."
+    )
+
+
+def _sse(event: str, data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return f"event: {event}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"
+
+
+def _to_openai_messages(request: ChatRequest) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT}]
+    for message in request.messages:
+        messages.append({"role": message.role, "content": message.content})
+    return messages
+
+
+def _openai_tools(mcp_tools: list[Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return [
+        {
+            "type": "function",
+            "function": {
+                "name": tool.name,
+                "description": tool.description,
+                "parameters": tool.input_schema,
+            },
+        }
+        for tool in mcp_tools
+    ]
+
+
+async def stream_chat(request: ChatRequest) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
+    """Yield SSE frames: status, delta, tool, message, canvas_dirty."""
+    yield _sse("status", {"phase": "health_check"})
+    healthy, _message = await check_llm_health(request.base_url, request.api_key, request.model)
+
+    last_user = next((m.content for m in reversed(request.messages) if m.role == "user"), "")
+
+    if not healthy:
+        reply = offline_fallback(last_user)
+        yield _sse("delta", {"text": reply})
+        yield _sse("message", {"content": reply})
+        return
+
+    yield _sse("status", {"phase": "mcp_tools"})
+    llm_client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=request.base_url, api_key=request.api_key, timeout=15.0)
+
+    async with McpClient(request.mcp_url) as mcp_client:
+        mcp_tools = await mcp_client.list_tools()
+        openai_tools = _openai_tools(mcp_tools)
+        messages: list[Any] = _to_openai_messages(request)
+
+        yield _sse("status", {"phase": "model"})
+        stream: Any = await llm_client.chat.completions.create(  # type: ignore[call-overload]
+            model=request.model,
+            messages=messages,
+            tools=openai_tools if openai_tools else None,
+            tool_choice="auto" if openai_tools else None,
+            stream=True,
+        )
+
+        buffered_text: list[str] = []
+        tool_calls: dict[int, dict[str, str]] = {}
+
+        async for chunk in stream:
+            delta = chunk.choices[0].delta
+            if delta.content:
+                buffered_text.append(delta.content)
+            for tool_call in delta.tool_calls or []:
+                entry = tool_calls.setdefault(
+                    tool_call.index, {"id": "", "name": "", "arguments": ""}
+                )
+                if tool_call.id:
+                    entry["id"] = tool_call.id
+                if tool_call.function is not None:
+                    if tool_call.function.name:
+                        entry["name"] = tool_call.function.name
+                    if tool_call.function.arguments:
+                        entry["arguments"] += tool_call.function.arguments
+
+        if not tool_calls:
+            content = "".join(buffered_text)
+            if content:
+                yield _sse("delta", {"text": content})
+            yield _sse("message", {"content": content})
+            return
+
+        messages.append(
+            {
+                "role": "assistant",
+                "content": None,
+                "tool_calls": [
+                    {
+                        "id": entry["id"],
+                        "type": "function",
+                        "function": {
+                            "name": entry["name"],
+                            "arguments": entry["arguments"] or "{}",
+                        },
+                    }
+                    for entry in tool_calls.values()
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+
+        for entry in tool_calls.values():
+            name = entry["name"]
+            yield _sse("tool", {"name": name, "status": "start"})
+            try:
+                arguments = json.loads(entry["arguments"] or "{}")
+            except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                arguments = {}
+
+            try:
+                result = await mcp_client.call_tool(name, arguments)
+                result_str = str(result)
+                yield _sse("tool", {"name": name, "status": "ok", "preview": result_str[:280]})
+            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+                result_str = f"Error calling {name}: {exc}"
+                yield _sse("tool", {"name": name, "status": "error", "preview": result_str})
+
+            messages.append(
+                {
+                    "role": "tool",
+                    "tool_call_id": entry["id"],
+                    "name": name,
+                    "content": result_str,
+                }
+            )
+
+        yield _sse("canvas_dirty", {"value": True})
+
+        final_stream: Any = await llm_client.chat.completions.create(
+            model=request.model,
+            messages=messages,
+            stream=True,
+        )
+        final_parts: list[str] = []
+        async for chunk in final_stream:
+            delta = chunk.choices[0].delta
+            if delta.content:
+                final_parts.append(delta.content)
+                yield _sse("delta", {"text": delta.content})
+
+        yield _sse("message", {"content": "".join(final_parts)})
+
+
+__all__ = ["SYSTEM_PROMPT", "offline_fallback", "stream_chat"]

+"""MCP hydration and passthrough writes, ported from the Streamlit app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import contextlib
+import json
+from typing import Any
+
+from agentic_odi_core import ODIService, ToolName
+from fastapi import HTTPException
+from fastmcp import Client as McpClient
+
+from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.probes import is_endpoint_reachable
+from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.seed import seed_payload
+
+MCP_CALL_TIMEOUT = 3.0
+
+
+async def fetch_canvas(mcp_url: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Fetch live canvas data from FastMCP, falling back to the seed prototype."""
+    jobs: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    steps: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    if not is_endpoint_reachable(mcp_url, timeout=0.3):
+        return {**seed_payload(), "source": "seed"}
+
+    with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
+        mcp_client = McpClient(mcp_url)
+        async with mcp_client:
+            raw_jobs = await asyncio.wait_for(mcp_client.call_tool(ToolName.GET_JOBS.value, {}), timeout=1.5)
+            try:
+                parsed_jobs = json.loads(str(raw_jobs))
+                if isinstance(parsed_jobs, list):
+                    jobs = parsed_jobs
+            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
+                jobs = []
+
+            for job in jobs:
+                job_id = job.get("id")
+                if not job_id:
+                    continue
+
+                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
+                    raw_steps = await asyncio.wait_for(
+                        mcp_client.call_tool(ToolName.GET_JOB_MAP.value, {"job_id": job_id}), timeout=1.0
+                    )
+                    parsed_steps = json.loads(str(raw_steps))
+                    if isinstance(parsed_steps, list):
+                        steps.extend(parsed_steps)
+
+                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
+                    raw_outcomes = await asyncio.wait_for(
+                        mcp_client.call_tool(ToolName.GET_OUTCOMES.value, {"job_id": job_id}), timeout=1.0
+                    )
+                    parsed_outcomes = json.loads(str(raw_outcomes))
+                    if isinstance(parsed_outcomes, list):
+                        outcomes.extend(parsed_outcomes)
+
+    if not jobs:
+        return {**seed_payload(), "source": "seed"}
+
+    return {"jobs": jobs, "steps": steps, "outcomes": outcomes, "source": "mcp"}
+
+
+def fetch_local_canvas(service: ODIService) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read the canvas directly from the local service, no HTTP round trip."""
+    jobs = [job.model_dump() for job in service.get_jobs()]
+    steps: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for job in jobs:
+        job_id = job["id"]
+        steps.extend(step.model_dump() for step in service.get_job_map(job_id))
+        outcomes.extend(outcome.model_dump() for outcome in service.get_outcomes(job_id))
+    return {"jobs": jobs, "steps": steps, "outcomes": outcomes, "source": "local"}
+
+
+async def call_mcp_tool(mcp_url: str, tool: str, arguments: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """Invoke an MCP tool, surfacing failures as HTTP 502."""
+    if not is_endpoint_reachable(mcp_url, timeout=0.3):
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"MCP server unreachable at {mcp_url}")
+
+    try:
+        async with McpClient(mcp_url) as mcp_client:
+            result = await asyncio.wait_for(
+                mcp_client.call_tool(tool, arguments), timeout=MCP_CALL_TIMEOUT
+            )
+            return str(result)
+    except HTTPException:
+        raise
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"Error calling {tool}: {exc}") from exc

+"""Connection probing and LLM health checks, ported from the Streamlit app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import os
+import socket
+from urllib.parse import urlparse
+
+from openai import AsyncOpenAI
+
+DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "http://localhost:8001/v1"
+DEFAULT_API_KEY = "local"
+DEFAULT_MODEL = "local-tools-model"
+DEFAULT_MCP_URL = "http://localhost:8000/mcp"
+
+OFFLINE_MESSAGE = "LLM server offline (Local Studio Mode enabled)"
+
+
+def defaults() -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Streamlit-compatible environment defaults (same variable names)."""
+    return {
+        "base_url": os.getenv("AGENTIC_ODI_BASE_URL", DEFAULT_BASE_URL),
+        "api_key": os.getenv("AGENTIC_ODI_API_KEY", DEFAULT_API_KEY),
+        "model_name": os.getenv("AGENTIC_ODI_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL),
+        "mcp_url": os.getenv("AGENTIC_ODI_MCP_URL", DEFAULT_MCP_URL),
+    }
+
+
+def is_endpoint_reachable(url: str, timeout: float = 0.3) -> bool:
+    """Quick socket check to verify a port is open without hanging on HTTP reads."""
+    try:
+        parsed = urlparse(url)
+        host = parsed.hostname or "localhost"
+        port = parsed.port or (443 if parsed.scheme == "https" else 80)
+        with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=timeout):
+            return True
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+
+
+def classify_llm_error(exc: Exception) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    message = str(exc)
+    lower = message.lower()
+    connection_indicators = [
+        "connection error",
+        "connection aborted",
+        "failed to establish a new connection",
+        "timed out",
+        "timeout",
+        "connection refused",
+    ]
+    if any(indicator in lower for indicator in connection_indicators):
+        return "connection_error", message
+    return "error", message
+
+
+async def check_llm_health(base_url: str, api_key: str, model_name: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
+    """Non-blocking LLM health probe with an instant socket pre-check."""
+    if not is_endpoint_reachable(base_url, timeout=0.3):
+        return False, OFFLINE_MESSAGE
+
+    client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=base_url, api_key=api_key, timeout=1.2)
+    try:
+        await asyncio.wait_for(client.models.list(), timeout=1.2)
+        return True, "LLM backend is reachable."
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+        status, detail = classify_llm_error(exc)
+        return False, f"{status}: {detail}"
